basis: Douglas Dynamics publicly established the threshold crossing on October 28, 2024. Consolidated GAAP net sales for the three months ended September 30 were $129,398,000 in 2024 and $144,121,000 in 2023. The 2024 actual was 10.22% lower and below the $136,914,950 cutoff. The earliest date remains unresolved because I could verify listings for the May 8 and September 20 investor presentations but could not verify their contents, original publication dates, or event hosts. The upper_bound records the October 28 actual.

coverage.detail: The February 26 Q4 2023 release introduced a full-year 2024 net sales range of $600 million to $660 million. It gave no consolidated Q3 2024 ceiling.
The April 29 Q1 release cut the full-year sales high end to $640 million and retained the $600 million low end. Its other sales targets concerned individual segments over the long term.
The issuer’s April 30 Q1 event page links both Audio and Earnings Webcast to this address. The host URL returned a cache miss.
A secondary transcript of the April 30 call was readable through closing remarks and Q&A. I found no explicit consolidated Q3 sales upper bound.

The July 29 Q2 release maintained full-year sales guidance of $600 million to $640 million. Subtracting reported first-half sales of $295.557 million implies $304.443 million to $344.443 million for Q3 and Q4 combined. Q3 alone cannot be determined from that range.
The issuer’s July 30 Q2 event page links both Audio and Earnings Webcast to this address. The host URL returned a cache miss.

The secondary transcript includes management remarks and Q&A. The approximate 65/35 split applied to Attachments preseason shipments across Q2 and Q3. The Q3 margin discussion concerned adjusted EBITDA. Neither supplies a consolidated sales ceiling. The linked supplemental slide PDF also returned a cache miss at https://files.quartr.com/conference-calls/afc01-2026-01-20-06-07-48.pdf?ref=TWFya2V0QmVhdCBNZWRpYSBMTEM%3D.

The historical index lists investor slides on May 8 and September 20, 2024. A second index at https://www.tradingview.com/symbols/NYSE-PLOW/documents/ also lists 2024 presentations. Neither yielded a readable full deck in this review.

The issuer’s visible presentation list reaches back to May 2025. The historical lookup at https://web.archive.org/web/20240930/https://ir.douglasdynamics.com/news-events/presentations was inaccessible. The issuer calendar at https://ir.douglasdynamics.com/news-events/ir-calendar/past identifies the April and July earnings calls but supplies no event page for either indexed deck.

Sidoti held a conference September 18–19. Its recording link at https://www.meetmax.com/sched/event_109663/conference_presentations.html?bank_access=0&event_id=109663 returned an error page. Sidoti’s published schedule at https://s24.q4cdn.com/538403808/files/doc_news/Sidoti-Events-LLCs-Virtual-September-Small-Cap-Conference-2024.pdf contains no Douglas entry. I could not tie the September 20 deck to this host.
The similarly dated September 20 SEC slide exhibit belongs to the 2023 filing. It cannot verify the September 2024 presentation.

The September 3 Form 8-K concerned Item 5.02 personnel matters. The September 5 issuer release at https://ir.douglasdynamics.com/news-events/press-releases/detail/218/douglas-dynamics-declares-quarterly-cash-dividend announced a $0.295 quarterly dividend. Neither gave Q3 sales guidance.

The September 11 sale-leaseback raised $64.2 million from operating properties the company leased back. The Q3 income statement separately recorded the $42.298 million gain. Both operating segments remain in consolidated net sales for both comparative quarters.
The September 17 release announced management changes and supplied no consolidated Q3 sales figure.
The October 15 notice scheduled the release for after market close October 28 and the call for October 29. It disclosed no preliminary sales figure.
The October 28 results exhibit gives the precise comparative net sales figures in the Consolidated Statements of Income. The three-month columns show 129,398 and 144,121 in thousands of dollars.

publication_date_evidence: The issuer’s release archive at https://ir.douglasdynamics.com/news-events/press-releases?page=3 timestamps the actual-results announcement October 28, 2024 at 6:05 p.m. EDT. Exhibit 99.1 carries the same October 28 dateline. October 29 was the call and filing date. The timestamp establishes when the actual became public, while the two earlier presentation listings leave the first disclosure date open.
